name: rc-storybook-e2e

scripts.lint: cd .. && eslint web e2e/*.mjs eslint.config.mjs && prettier --check web e2e/*.mjs e2e/package.json eslint.config.mjs .github && cd e2e && knip && node i18n-markup.mjs
scripts.lint:prune-directives: cd .. && eslint --fix --fix-type directive web e2e/*.mjs eslint.config.mjs && prettier --write web e2e/*.mjs eslint.config.mjs
scripts.format: cd .. && prettier --write web e2e/*.mjs e2e/package.json eslint.config.mjs .github

description: Tooling for the storybook: the end-to-end test, ESLint, Prettier and knip.
